credentials.title: Protocol key
credentials.description: Paste the Base64-encoded PKCS#1 PEM extracted from your own app.

cloud.title: Cloud backup and push (all optional)
cloud.description: Cloud needs all five fields. A push secret enables the mini-agent webhook.

error.invalid_name: Expected a name like BMC_E5xxxxxxxx or BMC_E6xxxxxxxx.
error.invalid_pem: Not a Base64-encoded RSA-1024 PKCS#1 private key. See tools/README.md to extract it from your own app.
error.cloud_incomplete: Fill all five cloud fields, or leave them all empty.

abort.not_supported: This device is not a supported BMC E5/E6 ventilator.

init.title: Cloud re-authentication
init.description: Sends one SMS with a login code. The integration keeps its own session, separate from the app.

code.title: Enter the SMS code
code.description: Enter the code that was just texted to you.

error.sms_failed: The cloud refused to send an SMS. Try again later.
error.code_failed: That code was rejected or expired.

abort.cloud_not_configured: Configure the cloud backup first (access token, serial, base URL).

cloud_auth.title: Cloud re-authentication needed
cloud_auth.description: The Remot cloud rejected the stored tokens, so the score channel is paused. Open the integration's options and run the SMS login to get a new token pair.
